component.name: Tortuga
component.summary: Floating islands, lantern light and a harbour at dusk

description.p: A dark style for the FlickOS desktop: slate title bars with thin buttons that get a round face under the pointer, a lantern copper accent, a deep slate terminal, and an island harbour at dusk on the wallpaper, with lanterns along the quay and their light in the water.

It comes with a layout of the same name: three floating islands at the top with the apps button, the clock and the status, and a dock at the bottom with your four desktops as a two-by-two grid beside it. While a window fills the screen the islands join into one panel and the dock hides. Use sets both; you can still pick another layout in Settings.
